ruleDefinitions.name: Osacompile Execution By Potentially Suspicious Applet/Osascript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential suspicious applet or osascript executing "osacompile".

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\/applet$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\/osascript$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*osacompile.*"))
